rows.displayName: The Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis: A Zero-Free Half-Plane Re s > 7/8

claim.ja: K=Q(√−3)上の全有限位数Hecke関数と全Dirichlet関数にRe s>7/8の零点なし。主指標の極を許す。最小二次非剰余のpolylog上界と決定的平方根抽出も主張。
claim.en: No zeros for Re s>7/8 for all finite-order Hecke L-functions over K=Q(√−3) and all Dirichlet L-functions, with the principal pole allowed. Also claims polylogarithmic least nonresidues and deterministic square-root extraction.

role.ja: 完成theta和の反射/Poisson比較。内部11/12段階の後、素数補償と二つのモーメント評価で境界を改善。
role.en: Reflected/Poisson comparison of completed theta sums; an internal 11/12 stage is strengthened using prime compensation and two moment estimates.

claim.ja: 同じHecke/Dirichlet族にRe s>11/12の零点なし。q≤xの等差数列素数計数に絶対的・有効なO(x^(11/12) log x)誤差を主張。
claim.en: No zeros for Re s>11/12 for the same Hecke/Dirichlet families; claims an absolute effective O(x^(11/12) log x) prime-counting error for q≤x.

role.ja: 六次Möbius平均二乗、theta変換、cube逆変換の有限反復から11/12を得る別構成。系の外部明示公式の定数管理は未照合。
role.en: Alternative construction through sextic Möbius mean squares, theta transformation, and finite cube-inversion iteration. External explicit-formula constants for the corollary remain unchecked.

claim.ja: 全q≥3の原始非主実指標のすべての実零点β∈(0,1)に、絶対c>0で(1−β)log q≥c。
claim.en: An absolute c>0 satisfies (1−β)log q≥c for every real zero β∈(0,1) of every primitive nonprincipal real character of conductor q≥3.

role.ja: 実零点による素数の偏りを、体に一様な補間とFrobenius可除性で行列式ノルムの矛盾へ移す。
role.en: Prime bias from a real zero combines with field-uniform interpolation and Frobenius divisibility to contradict norm bounds for a determinant.
